name: Mystery Island：Enigmatic Painting
detailed_description:
Unravel the mystery, explore the shadows lurking within human nature!

After a difficult journey, Ada has found her sister and officially become a detective. Various cases soon follow. This time, Ada is hired by a painter's wife to search for her missing husband, Ben, within a castle on the remote Island. Yet, this ancient fortress, filled with strange paintings, hides far more than the truth behind a disappearance case—

The twisted father-son relationship between the adopted son Jared and the castle's master, Frank... the conspiracy behind the butler's bizarre death... the hallucinogenic drug coveted by a mysterious organization...

Amidst layers of shocking twists, the darkness and complexity of human nature are quietly rising to the surface.

Key Features:

  • Immersive Suspense Thriller: A tightly woven plot full of suspense. From awakening with amnesia to uncovering the truth, each twist will shatter your expectations!

  • Mind-Bending Puzzles: Break through illusions, collect crucial items, search for clues – piece together the fragments of truth with your wits.

  • Classic Aesthetic Experience: Immersive visuals and sound design perfectly recreate the castle's haunting atmosphere.

Critical Plot Points:

  • A Fatal Misunderstanding: How did an invitation addressed to the wrong name and an undelivered painting lead to a tragic father-son rift?

  • Deceptive Identities: Nothing in the castle seems certain. Who is impersonating others in the shadows?

  • The Ultimate Twist: The castle's treasure is undeniably alluring, but is this truly the goal of the treasure hunt?

"Mystery Island: Enigmatic Painting" – The truth lies hidden in every tap. Follow Ada's footsteps and unravel the mystery step by step!
